description: Pocket security multi-tool for Cardputer Zero: Wi-Fi capture, wardriving and CVE-linked network auditing, sub-GHz sweep and raw OOK capture, NFC probe, drone/ALPR surveillance sniffing, Meshtastic and MeshCore mesh modes, and a LAN web portal.

store.description: LokiCZ turns a Cardputer Zero and its radio caps into a pocket security lab. With a supported USB Wi-Fi dongle it captures WPA handshakes (passive, deauth-free), wardrives to WiGLE-format CSV, and runs a Bjorn-style network audit — host discovery, port and service scans, CVE correlation with NVD links — from the device or its built-in LAN web portal; the CC1101 cap sweeps 433/915 MHz, records raw OOK remote signals to Flipper .sub files, and probes the cap's ST25R3916 NFC frontend; a passive sniffer flags drone Remote ID and known surveillance-device fingerprints over Wi-Fi and BLE; and the LoRa cap runs Meshtastic or MeshCore under one supervisor — one radio, one owner. Built for your own lab gear and networks you are authorized to test. USB WI-FI DONGLES (Debian 13 / kernel 6.12, in-kernel drivers): recommended — ALFA AWUS036ACM (MT7612U, dual-band, full monitor + injection). Also plug-and-play: ALFA AWUS036ACHM, Panda PAU0B, ASUS USB-AC51 (MT7610U); ALFA AWUS036NHA (AR9271, 2.4 GHz); Panda PAU09 (RT5572) and PAU06 (RT5372); RTL8822BU adapters (capture works, injection limited). RTL8812AU/8811AU adapters (e.g. Archer T2U Nano) also work on the lokicz image — its Raspberry Pi 6.18 kernel carries their in-kernel driver, though a stock Debian 13 install is too old for them. Full supported-dongle list: docs/DONGLES.md in the source repo.
store.summary: Pocket security multi-tool: capture, wardrive, sub-GHz, NFC, mesh
